learning_objective: 🎯 Let us discover the invisible pushes and pulls around us, and learn about simple tools that make our work easy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Whenever we move something, we use force! Opening a drawer is a pull, and kicking a football is a push. Force can make things move, stop, or change shape.
Friction is a special force that slows things down when they rub together. It is what stops your bicycle when you press the brakes, and helps you walk without slipping!
Machines are tools that help us do heavy work easily. A pair of scissors, a wheel on a toy car, and a bottle opener are all simple but amazing machines!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Toy Car Friction Race!
fun_activity.instructions: Roll a toy car on a smooth floor, and then roll it on a rough carpet. See which surface makes the car stop faster because of friction!

quick_recap: ⭐ A push or a pull is called force.
⭐ Friction is the force that stops things from slipping and sliding everywhere.
⭐ Simple machines like wheels and pulleys help humans do work much faster.
